programme.title: Unknown India – The land of changes | E01
programme.desc: The creators of the program will present the diversity of flavors and landscapes of the Indian subcontinent. They will take viewers on a journey through the great rivers, deserts and tropical forests of this region. They will show the uniqueness of India as a land where nature coexists with civilization, and some animals cannot be found elsewhere. They will visit, among others: Valley of Flowers National Park in the western Himalayas, you will see baby turtles lounging on the eastern coast, rhinos and lions in the Gir reserve. The creators will talk about seasonal climatic phenomena that pose a challenge to animals living in India. At the same time, thanks to them, various species could develop on the subcontinent. Great Britain. 2015. documentary series

programme.title: Unknown India – The Land of Mountains | E02
programme.desc: The creators of the program will present the diversity of flavors and landscapes of the Indian subcontinent. They will take viewers on a journey through the great rivers, deserts and tropical forests of this region. They will show the uniqueness of India as a land where nature coexists with civilization, and some animals cannot be found elsewhere. They will visit, among others: Valley of Flowers National Park in the western Himalayas, you will see baby turtles lounging on the eastern coast, rhinos and lions in the Gir reserve. A trip to the Indian mountains - the Western Ghats, which are covered with lush forests and tea plantations. Viewers will also be able to admire the mighty Himalayas. Great Britain. 2015. documentary series

programme.title: Unknown India – The Land of Rivers | E03
programme.desc: The creators of the program will present the diversity of flavors and landscapes of the Indian subcontinent. They will take viewers on a journey through the great rivers, deserts and tropical forests of this region. They will show the uniqueness of India as a land where nature coexists with civilization, and some animals cannot be found elsewhere. They will visit, among others: Valley of Flowers National Park in the western Himalayas, you will see baby turtles lounging on the eastern coast, rhinos and lions in the Gir reserve. In this episode, viewers will be able to admire the Ganges River, which flows from a sacred source deep in the Himalayas and forms a vast delta in the Sundarbans forests. The reservoir carries valuable nutrients and irrigates the land. Great Britain. 2015. documentary series

programme.title: Borneo: a wilderness full of wonders
programme.desc: There is a laboratory in the village of Sukau in Borneo. Scientists working there observe animal species inhabiting this region of the world. They also build rope bridges and try to recreate the destroyed forest... Germany. 2024. documentary film

programme.title: Colorful forests: Tenasserim mountains in Thailand
programme.desc: The Tenasserim Mountains are rich in biodiversity and home to many animal species. And all this thanks to the dense forests. Their diversity and the importance of their protection will be shown... Germany. 2024. documentary film

programme.title: Animals: masters of survival – Top flights | S01E04
programme.desc: Many animal species have developed unique survival skills through evolution. Viewers will meet twenty of their representatives in various survival categories. Viewers will learn what species of animals live at high altitudes. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Sharks vs. killer whales
programme.desc: The great white shark is not at the top of the food chain. His power means he could be on it. However, killer whale attacks made them the kings of the oceans. The creators will take a look at these majestic creatures and wonder if sharks have any chance against them... Great Britain. 2025. documentary film

programme.title: Lion rules – Family arrangements | E04
programme.desc: In the floodplains of the lower reaches of the African Kuando River, called Chobe, a pride of lions dominates the local ecosystem. The clan, consisting of a dozen or so individuals, is ruled by two brothers and a brave female. The rebellious young lion Einstein stands out from them. Even though he should leave the family herd, he stubbornly sticks to his loved ones. With the arrival of the dry season, lions start fighting for survival. They try to protect their territory and offspring from rivals. When the cubs appear, Einstein decides to leave for good and start a new life. The flood waters are receding and game is returning to the banks of the Chobe River. There is a time of abundance in nature. While Callera and Tom Toma fight their enemies, Keeza and her pup escape. After many difficulties, Einstein finds a partner. South Africa. 2025. nature series

programme.title: Wild Cuba: A trip to the Caribbean | E02
programme.desc: Colin Stafford Johnson takes viewers back to a time just 50 years ago when Earth's wildlife seemed abundant. It is a journey into a world that may soon disappear forever. The expedition begins in the south of the island in the Zapata Swamp. The largest single protected area in the entire Caribbean is home to the world's smallest bird, the bee hummingbird. Decades of a conservation-minded socialist government, US embargoes and minimal development have left the region largely unchanged for five decades. Regardless of politics, Cuba's isolation has created a natural citadel in the Caribbean. Forests cover large areas of the island, and its waters contain some of the richest coral reefs in the world. Half of Cuba's flora and fauna are found only here - from the local species of crocodiles and snakes, to the smallest birds and frogs on the planet... Austria. 2020. documentary film

programme.title: In Search of Rain | E02
programme.desc: A herd of elephants faces a challenge when the river dries up due to lack of rain. Phoenix, the leader of a pack of wild dogs, is fighting against time: she has to feed five puppies. In the dry riverbed, elephants are trying to dig holes. Culet, a female cheetah and recently also a mother, is looking for prey. To do this, he ventures into the lions' territory. Phoenix is ​​in trouble because of the hyenas. Canada. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Enchanted mountains: in the heart of Germany
programme.desc: Uwe Anders sets off to the German Harz Mountains to show viewers the richness of the local nature. In winter you can encounter snowstorms there, and in summer there are heavy rains. The landscape is also full of beautiful landscapes... Germany. 2019. documentary film

programme.title: Survive the asteroid | E02
programme.desc: More than 66 billion years ago, a giant asteroid hit our planet and thus ended the age of dinosaurs. Researchers are wondering why animals that weighed more than 500 grams were unable to survive. Experts will consider what we know about the species that survived this collision... France, Great Britain. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Earth – planet of life – Planet of people | E05
programme.desc: Earth has survived countless collisions and disasters in the solar system. From asteroid impacts to volcanic eruptions and climate crises. The program will show what some of them looked like. Humans dominated the Earth very quickly. Despite being the dominant species, humans still need to be on guard. Humanity must watch out for threats from volcanoes and asteroids. Germany. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: The most dangerous sharks
programme.desc: Residents of certain areas of the USA and Australia are particularly vulnerable to attacks by bullhead sharks. Former navy diver Paul de Gelder and marine biologist Craig O'Connell try to find out whether this fish species is actually one of the most dangerous in the world... South Africa. 2025. documentary film

programme.desc: «90 years of LaLiga (2019): Abel Resino» Abel Resino holds the unbeaten record in the history of LaLiga. As an Atlético de Madrid player, he entered the Guinness Book by keeping a clean sheet for 1,275 minutes, which goes from November 25, 1990, in which Claudio scored a goal against him in Mallorca-Atlético and March 17, 1991, on matchday 26, when Luis Enrique managed to beat him in the 45th minute of Atlético-Sporting de Gijón played in Vicente Calderon. A total of 14 consecutive games without conceding a goal in the 1990/1991 season. A mark that is still valid in professional football and that helped him win the Zamora trophy with 17 goals conceded in 33 games. Champion of the Copa del Rey, in 1995 he decided to sign for Rayo Vallecano of Madrid to play his last active season. Abel played a total of 264 games in the highest category of Spanish football

programme.desc: «Football according to Raúl (1): Almost Champions» It is often said that we only remember the champion, that no one remembers the runner-up. But there are teams that, due to their trajectory and their way of falling, have gone down in history despite not lifting the trophy. This is the case of Espanyol in the 1988 UEFA, which lost on penalties against Bayer Leverkusen, and of Alavés in the 2001 UEFA, which was defeated 5-4 by Liverpool with a golden goal in its own goal. Raúl tells us the story of those two modest teams that, against all odds, reached their first European final, eliminating the greats of Europe. programme.title: 30 for 30: June 17, 1994
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

But their leader, Ava, decides to lead her family south to the heart of their territory for a showdown with the Nomads | Big Cat Country is a documentary series revolving around two neighbouring lion prides of the great rift valley, in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. programme.desc: 2024 г. Год: 2024. Страна: Australija. Год: 2024. S1, Ep3 «Planet Weird»…Meet nature's most wanted and see why the baddest of the bad don't get the respect they deserve. programme.title: Guardians of the Wild: The Mating Game (S2E3). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Kanada, 2018. S2, Ep3
programme.desc: 2018 г. Год: 2018. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2018. S2, Ep3 «Guardians of the Wild»…Meet Madonna, a very special monkey. She's the first Kinda baboon ever to be studied from birth to adulthood and now, critically, she's looking for a mate. Only recently identified as a species in their own right, Kinda baboons are little known and little understood. But Madonna is helping change all that. She may just hold the key to unlocking the secrets of the Kinda's unique female-male relationships. These are baboons like no others | They are the protectors of the precious, wild animals that roam Zambia's dramatic landscapes, aiding them with medical care and protection from sinister poachers, standing proudly as the guardians of the wild. Our planet is in danger of losing these remarkable species of animals, from elephants to black rhinos, mainly due to the disdainful pilfering of their ivory. These conservationists risk their lives to protect these beloved creatures, whether it's the aforementioned species, Kinda baboons, lions, or leopards, monitoring their numbers and attempting to ensure their future remains as positive as possible. Documentary series | Director: Jason Holmes

For many species, it's the very reason why individuals come together. Protecting the empire is imperative to survival. For these animals, protection means isolation – finding sanctuary from the threats outside their boundaries | Animals congregate in places where their basic needs can be met: havens from predators where competition for food is manageable and breeding opportunities are abundant. programme.title: In the animal world. 28 pp.
programme.desc: The fauna of our planet is vibrant and diverse, since the climatic conditions in different parts of it differ. How do animals, birds, fish, reptiles and insects hunt, reproduce and coexist in close proximity to humans? What habits are characteristic of different types of animals and how do they care for their offspring? An educational and exciting documentary project with fragments of the legendary show by Nikolai Drozdov. Great Britain, 2018, educational

programme.title: d/s Survival strategy. Endless Selection: The Mating Game

programme.title: My wild cats. My European cats

programme.title: d/s Love in the wild. 3 s.

France, 2010

programme.title: The miracle egg
programme.desc: The question is an age-old one: Did the chicken or the egg come first? And just one of the mysteries about the lime shell that David Attenborough wants to decipher. Why do birds lay eggs? \n\nImportant factors that can influence the miracle egg are nest building, food supply, breeding location, brood care and many more. A lot happens until a chick is ready to hatch out of its protective shell...

programme.title: CHIẾN BINH THỰC TẾ ẢO - VR FIGHTER
programme.desc: Vệ sĩ Long Wei mắc chứng rối loạn căng thẳng sau chấn thương tâm lý sau cái chết của vợ. Một ngày nọ, anh gặp Amy, người đang làm việc cho một công ty công nghệ VR và được mời dùng thử sản phẩm mới. Sau cuộc thử nghiệm, Long Wei trở thành chiến binh VR của công ty và mặc bộ áo giáp mới được phát minh. Tuy nhiên, khi những người đàn ông có vũ trang bí ẩn đột nhập, một trận chiến khốc liệt vừa mới bắt đầu...

programme.title: VÕ TÒNG BÁO THÙ - WUSONG VS XIMENQING
programme.desc: Ngô Song phát hiện ra chuyện chị dâu ngoại tình với một người đàn ông giàu có, Tây Môn Khánh. Qing gài bẫy Song và đày anh ta trong một năm, trong thời gian đó người anh trai kém may mắn của anh ta bị sát hại và hỏa táng. Cuối cùng, khi Song trở về nhà, anh đưa vụ án ra tòa nhưng thẩm phán gạt nó sang một bên và đột ngột đóng lại. Liệu Song cuối cùng có thể trả thù cho cái chết của anh trai mình?

programme.title: 10 ĐỐI 10 (MÙA 3) - 10 FIGHT 10 SEASON 3
programme.desc: Chương trình quy tụ các siêu sao, ca sĩ, võ sĩ, người mẫu và rapper Thái Lan vào sàn đấu quyền anh nổi tiếng. Phần 2 có trận đấu đầu tiên của nữ Thái Lan và Phần 3 có hai vận động viên giành huy chương vàng Thế vận hội cạnh tranh chức vô địch. Chương trình đấm bốc độc đáo này mang đến sự giải trí toàn diện, với các buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp, trang phục xa hoa và những trận chiến đẫm máu thực sự!

programme.title: VÒNG XOÁY ĐEN TỐI - SONG OF THE ASSASSINS
programme.desc: Một sát thủ trẻ được giao nhiệm vụ đầu tiên khi bí mật điều tra nguyên nhân vụ thảm sát gia đình anh nhiều năm trước. Trong khi thực hiện nhiệm vụ, anh thấy mình vướng vào một âm mưu chính trị đã được lên kế hoạch từ nhiều năm và phải sử dụng kỹ năng sát thủ của mình để giải quyết bất cứ điều gì xảy ra theo cách của mình.

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn kể về bốn nam nhân vật nổi tiếng đến từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được đài thọ toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho các “anh em”!

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!
